newsitem.title: USA: Northern sees Minn. 581 MW unit back April.
newsitem.headline: Northern sees Minn. 581 MW unit back April.

text.p: Northern States Power Co's 581 megawatt (MW) Allen King coal-fired power plant should return to service in the first week of April following a scheduled maintenance outage, a company spokeswoman said.
The King plant is located in Oak Parks Heights, near Stillwater, Minn.
Also no restart date has been set for Northern States' 712 MW Sherburne County coal-fired unit 2, which is out of service for a tube leak repair, the spokeswoman said.
The adjacent 712 MW Sherburne County unit 1 and 871 MW Sherburne County unit 3, also located in Becker, Minn., were operating normally at full capacity, the spokeswoman said.
Separately, Northern States' 500 MW Prairie Island nuclear power unit 2 has been off line since Jan 24 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
Prairie Island 2, located in Red Wing, Minn., was expected to return to service near March 23.
